metadata.title: रंगीन धागों में बुनी आदिवासी पहचान | Fading Threads: The Vanishing Art of Tripura's Tribal Weaving
metadata.description: In this compelling ground report from Tripura, we delve into the vibrant tapestry of the state's diverse tribal communities and their unique art of handloom weaving. Once a thriving tradition, the colorful fabrics and intricate designs woven by skilled tribal women are now at risk of disappearing. We explore the rich cultural heritage of Tripura's 19 tribes, their distinct styles of clothing, and the challenges faced by this age-old craft. Join us on this poignant journey as we shine a light on the fading threads that weave together the identity and history of Tripura's tribal communities.
